title: Chronomark
description: The <keyword>Chronomark</keyword> is an upgraded version of the <keyword>Timedoor Marker</keyword>. It supports a <keyword>portal offset of up to 5 blocks</keyword> in any direction, allowing the marker to be <positive>hidden underground or mounted on a ceiling</positive> while the Timedoor appears at a different height. It also provides <property>team-based access filtering</property> with <keyword>FTB Teams</keyword>.
